info.name: Ignition Gateway REST access-control overview API

params.name: includeVariants
params.description:
Include local variants in results, defaults to true. When true, there will be multiple entries for some languages, `value` will include the variant code, and `label` will include the location name in parentheses.
For example French would include variants for France and for Canada (amongst others), resulting in codes with the format fr_FR, fr_CA, etc., and labels French (France) and French (Canada), etc.

items.docs: Returns codes and display names for all languages available for use by the gateways.
General status information about this Ignition Gateway.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip before returning results.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The name of a field to sort by. Use `asc(fieldName)` or `desc(fieldName)`
to specify the sort direction as ascending or descending, respectively.

params.name: search
params.description: A search string to filter items by. Terms separated by whitespace.

params.name: key_0
params.description: Filter items by field name, using format like `fieldName[op]=value` where `op` is one of: `eq` (equals), `ne` (not equals), `cn` (contains), `sw` (starts with), `ew` (ends with), `gt` (greater than), `gte` (greater than or equal), `lt` (less than), `lte` (less than or equal), `rgx` (regular expression).
